basic_info.description: Recently renovated Edwardian flat in the highly desirable Mission Dolores neighborhood, with a huge basement bonus storage room. Stunning stainless steel eat-in kitchen opens to the lovely dining room. Gorgeous living room with charming cathedral style windows and fireplace. High 10' ceilings and gorgeous new oak hardwood floors throughout. Separate office alcove area could be partitioned off to make a private study, office or a nursery. The living room could also be used as a 3rd bedroom. Stunning new bathrooms. Lots of period details still intact. There's an approximately 304 square foot exclusive basement bonus storage room for this unit, located directly underneath the unit, and it's also located just off the back patio and could be great as a workshop or studio. It could also possibly be converted to additional living space, buyer to investigate. Energy efficient upgrades including, all new appliances, dual pane windows, LED lights and a tankless water heater. New roof was installed in September of 2021 and the exterior was painted then as well.  Amazing location in the heart of the city, with a 99% walk score, and it's just steps away from a wide array of restaurants, nightlife, bars, shopping, and parks. Close to public transit and Dolores Park.
